title: Human Embryonic Gonad Dissociation with Trypsin-EDTA
author: Regina Hoo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.66fhhbn
materials: Samples arrive in hypothermosol solution. The gonad is washed with PBS and dissociated into single-cells following the protocol below.

Prepare digestion mix A B C 1 Reagents Volume Concentration (stock) 2 Trypsin-EDTA (0.25%) phenol red 4ml (depending on tissue size) 0.25% (1X) 3 DNaseI (0.1mg/ml) 40ul 10mg/ml Prepare complete media: A B C 1 Reagents Final conc. 2 RPMI 445ml 3 FBS 50ml 10% 4 Pen-strep 5ml 1% Prepare final resuspension buffer: A B C 1 Reagents Volume Concentration (stock) 2 PBS 5ml 3 BSA 0.04% 20ul 10%

steps.title: Fragment gonads with scalpel
steps.instruction: Cut each gonad into 2–20 pieces with a scalpel, adjusting the number according to developmental stage.

steps.title: Suspend fragments in Trypsin‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Place the fragments into a 15 mL tube containing 4 mL of 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA plus DNase I mix; for small tissues use 750 µL of the mix in an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Incubate with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube(s) at 37 °C for 15 min while rotating and shaking to distribute fragments on the tube wall. For small tissues perform three cycles of 5 min incubation at 37 °C interspersed with up‑and‑down pipetting.

steps.title: Check for remaining fragments
steps.instruction: If tissue fragments are still visible, continue incubation for an additional 5–10 min; otherwise proceed to the next step and note the observation.

steps.title: Add complete medium
steps.instruction: Add 9 mL of complete medium containing pen‑step and pipette up and down to mix. For small tissues add 500 µL and pipette up and down.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 100 µm filter into a 50 mL tube, then top up with complete medium to a final volume of 50 mL. For small tissues filter using a FACS tube strainer and transfer the filtrate to an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge first pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in PBS
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL PBS, and transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Optional RBC lysis
steps.instruction: If the pellet appears reddish, add RBC lysis buffer, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then add 1 mL PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min; wash once with PBS containing 0.04 % BSA. (Prepare RBC lysis buffer by diluting 10× stock with water.)

substeps.instruction: Dilute 10× RBC lysis buffer stock with water to make working solution.
Add RBC lysis buffer to the reddish pellet.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 250 µL PBS with 0.04 % BSA, adjusting the volume according to cell count; for small tissues resuspend in 100 µL PBS 0.04 % BSA.
